blocks.content: Write a program to modify elements of a vector.

items: Get integer inputs from the user and store them in the index and value variables.
Declare an integer vector marks and initialize it with the values 12, 24, and 36.
Change the element at the index position of the vector.
Print the updated vector in a new line.

blocks.content: Assumption: The user will only enter the numbers 0, 1, and 2 for index.
Hint: Use the at() function to insert value to the vector.
